text: The deck's too hot to stand on barefoot and the tar in the seams has gone soft. Glass Animals, Heat Waves. For once the title's just telling the truth.
Summer out here means the hatch open, the tins warm and Gerrit asleep on the roof. Seasick Steve, Summertime Boy. [dryly] I'm the summertime boy. He's the summertime gull.
Rain on the wheelhouse roof, the bucket under the leak doing its job. Radiohead, High and Dry. [dryly] One of those two words I can promise. The other one, not today.
Just a small-town girl, a midnight train, and a man in a wheelhouse who should be asleep. Journey, Don't Stop Believin'. The lighthouse is still going round, so I'm still going too.
First mug of the day, Opa coughing himself awake, and here's the helicopter. Oasis, Morning Glory. [mutters] Gerrit's already had his fish and his opinions.
Fog all round, and the island's gone. I know it's there, I can hear the bell. The xx, Islands. [quietly] Sometimes they disappear for a while. They come back.
The mug's sliding across the desk and the anchor chain's complaining. The Raconteurs, Steady, As She Goes. [to Gerrit] That's an order, not a description.
Dark out, and the only light for miles is the one on the point, sweeping over us every few seconds. Shine A Little Light, The Black Keys. Thank you, keeper.
Clouds all over the place, and one of them's got that bright edge where the light's getting round it. First Aid Kit, My Silver Lining. Right on time.
Late. The ferry's tied up, the lighthouse is doing its rounds, and this is as close to a club as Radio Alles gets. Balthazar, Nightclub. Dress code: jumper.
I can see people on the island's beach from here, little dots with towels. Django Django, Life's a Beach. I'll stay on the boat, thanks. The water's coming to me.
Clear sky, every star out, and not a single cloud between me and whatever's up there. The Killers, Spaceman. If they're coming, tonight's the night to land.
